description: Go through the pending items one at a time; I decide what happens to each.

content.text: List all pending items with saveslot_pending, starting with the one waiting longest, and show me each one's detail one at a time (the current value, the proposal or candidates, what it would change). For each, wait for me to say how to resolve it before calling saveslot_resolve; do not resolve any I have not decided on.
